question: In which of the following years was the Indian Association established?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1876**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Indian Association** was established in British India in the year **1876 **as the **first avowed nationalist organization**.

 
 
• The association was founded in Bengal by **Surendranath Banerjee **and **Ananda Mohan Bose**.
 
• The association was supported mainly by younger professional men among the Bengali intelligentsia.
 
• The association found an issue in opposing the **lowering **of the **age limit **for **civil service examinations** (1877).
 
• In **1878 **it **objected **to the **Vernacular Press Act**, which stifled the Indian press.
 
• It advocated** local self-government **and** tenant rights**.
